reason: A named independent lab and the batch report behind the QR code is what I look for, and at $24.99 for one box the risk is small. The counted sachet also helps, since I forget my vitamins on the counter half the time.
objection: It is a brand new product with no reviews yet, so I only have their word that the report is real until I match the batch number myself. Also two capsules every day is something I will probably skip some evenings.
would_change_my_mind: If the lab report turned out not to match the batch number, or the lab was one I could not verify, I would not buy.
